authors: Sungkyun Chang, Emmanouil Benetos, Holger Kirchhoff, Simon Dixon (QMUL / Huawei)
sourceRepositoryNote: The GitHub repository's default branch contains only LICENSE and README.md at commit 8a4fbcabdf660f9f06bcb6f12bbf00d9b3139b98 (2024-11-29); the README points at a pre-release issue comment for code. The runnable YourMT3+ code is published in the Hugging Face Space, which is what this image pins.

code.note: Only inference is used: model.init_train.initialize_trainer/update_config to rebuild the config the checkpoint was trained under, utils.task_manager.TaskManager for the tokenizer, model.ymt3.YourMT3 for the network, and utils.event2note + utils.note2event to turn tokens into Note dataclasses. No training path, no dataset path and no YouTube path is imported.
code.outputNote: ymt3_infer reads model.task_manager's decoded Note dataclasses directly (is_drum, program, onset, offset, pitch, velocity) instead of writing a MIDI file and parsing it back. A MIDI round trip would quantise onsets to ticks and lose exactly the millisecond resolution the benchmark grades on.

model.sha256Source: Hugging Face LFS pointer (X-Linked-ETag on resolve/<revision>/<path>), re-verified by sha256sum at image build and by /health

YPTF.MoE+Multi.argsSource: app.py of the pinned Space, branch model_name == 'YPTF.MoE+Multi (PS)'
YPTF.MoE+Multi.architecture: Perceiver-TF encoder with Mixture-of-Experts FFN (top-2 of 8), RoPE, spectral cross-attention; multi-channel T5-small decoder over 13 instrument groups
YPTF.MoE+Multi.challengeRank: 2nd of 14 in the 2025 AMT Challenge as 'YourMT3-YPTF-MoE-M', F1 0.5938 (winner MIROS 0.5998; MT3 baseline 0.3932)

YPTF+Single.argsSource: app.py of the pinned Space, branch model_name == 'YPTF+Single (noPS)'

YMT3+.argsSource: app.py of the pinned Space, branch model_name == 'YMT3+'
YMT3+.architecture: T5 encoder/decoder on mel spectrogram — the MT3-shaped member of the family
YMT3+.challengeRankNote: Not identified with a leaderboard row. The challenge table lists 'YourMT3-P' (0.3947) and 'YourMT3-YPTF-SP-V' (0.3305); neither name maps unambiguously onto a published checkpoint, so no rank is claimed for this variant.

logs/2024/mc13_256_g4_all_v7_mt3f_sqr_rm.note: 'YPTF.MoE+Multi (noPS)' — the Space's own default. Not loaded here; the PS variant is the one the challenge row corresponds to.

model.inputFormat: mono audio resampled to the checkpoint's sample rate (16 kHz), sliced into fixed input_frames segments and batched
model.outputFormat: Note dataclasses: is_drum, program (GM 0-127 after the checkpoint's midi_output_inverse_vocab), onset/offset in seconds, pitch, velocity

runtime.lightning: >=2.2.1 (imported for the trainer/config plumbing the checkpoint was saved under)

Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0'). Three statements, two answers. UNRESOLVED — counsel must decide before any distribution of this code. It does not block *measuring* the model, which is what this worker does.

weightsLicense.source: cardData.license of the mimbres/YourMT3 model repository (HF API, revision e45ebd70…)

trainingData.stated: YourMT3 dataset — Slakh2100, MusicNet, MAESTRO, GuitarSet, ENST-Drums, EGMD, MIR-ST500, RWC-Pop, URMP, IDMT-SMT-Bass, CMedia, MIR-1K (per the paper's dataset table and the repository's preprocess/ scripts)
trainingData.underlyingWorksCleared: no — the constituent corpora carry different terms and several (RWC-Pop, MIR-ST500, ENST-Drums) are research-use-only or licensed per-institution. The Apache-2.0 on the weights is the authors' grant over the weights; it is not a clearance of the recordings they were trained on.
trainingData.practicalNote: A transcription model is used here to read a user's own audio, not to generate anything resembling its training data. That is a materially weaker exposure than a generative model trained on the same corpora — but it is a legal judgement, not an engineering one, and this manifest does not make it.

licence.classification: LEGAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED — measured and benchmarked; not routed to users, and not promotable until the code-licence conflict is resolved and the training-corpus terms are read.
